description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent.

In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in both staff development and maintaining rigorous infection control standards. Your expertise will ensure our clinical team is well-trained and that our facility adheres to the highest safety and health protocols, directly impacting the well-being of our residents.

Join a supportive environment where your contributions are valued, and play a key role in fostering a culture of continuous learning and exceptional patient care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or education within a healthcare setting
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care
Strong communication and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to lead marketing efforts for a recently purchased facility, contributing significantly to its growth and community presence. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, results-driven individual eager to make a substantial impact.

As Marketing Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to drive census growth and enhance the facility's reputation. This includes building strong relationships with referral sources, managing community outreach, and ensuring a professional and presentable representation of the facility. The role requires a "hustler" mentality, with a commitment to achieving objectives and the flexibility to work occasional weekends.

This position offers a competitive compensation package for the right candidate, reflecting the importance of this role in the facility's strategic vision. Join a team dedicated to providing exceptional care and fostering a supportive environment.
requirements: Professional and presentable demeanor
Ability to work occasional weekends
Proven experience in healthcare marketing, preferably within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong communication and relationship-building skills
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and achieve marketing objectives
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is competitive and based on experience for the right candidate.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, providing an excellent opportunity for professionals seeking flexibility and impactful work within a supportive environment. If you are passionate about helping patients regain communication and swallowing abilities, this is an ideal opportunity.

This position comes with an attractive $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus, reflecting the urgency and value placed on securing top talent. You will be an integral part of a multidisciplinary team, contributing to comprehensive patient care plans and fostering a positive recovery journey for residents. We are looking for a compassionate and skilled SLP ready to make a significant difference.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a Per Diem Physical Therapist (PT). This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled and compassionate therapist to provide essential rehabilitation services on a flexible, as-needed basis. You will play a crucial role in helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life through personalized therapy plans.

We are seeking a motivated Physical Therapist who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering exceptional patient care. This PRN position offers the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life while making a significant impact within our community.

Compensation for this role is highly competitive, with an hourly rate ranging from $39.00 to $40.00, based on experience and qualifications. We value your expertise and dedication to patient recovery.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in Florida.
Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Physical Therapist, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills.
Ability to work flexible PRN shifts as needed.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for this role is highly competitive, with an hourly rate ranging from $39.00 to $40.00, based on experience and qualifications.

roleTitle: Therapy Professional (OT, PT, ST, COTA, PTA)
description: Are you a dedicated Occupational Therapist, Physical Therapist, Speech Therapist, Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA), or Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) looking for a rewarding opportunity? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL, is seeking passionate therapy professionals to join their team. This facility is committed to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for its staff.We are actively hiring for both full-time and part-time positions, offering competitive hourly rates. You will play a crucial role in helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life through comprehensive rehabilitation services. This is an urgent need to ensure continuous high-quality care for our residents.If you are a skilled and compassionate therapy professional ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Join a team where your expertise is valued, and your contributions directly enhance patient recovery and well-being.
requirements: Current state licensure/certification as an Occupational Therapist (OT), Physical Therapist (PT), Speech Therapist (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA), or Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA).
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred.
Ability to work full-time or part-time as required.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA) and Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) can expect to earn $28.00 - $37.00 per hour. Occupational Therapists (OT), Physical Therapists (PT), and Speech Therapists (ST) can expect to earn $40.00 - $46.00 per hour.

description:
Join a highly reputable commercial and industrial service provider known for its exceptional employee retention and long-term career opportunities. We are urgently seeking skilled Lead/Senior Commercial/Industrial HVAC Technicians to serve clients across the vibrant Chicago Metropolitan Area, including parts of Illinois, Wisconsin, and Indiana. This is an opportunity to become a vital part of a team where professionals thrive for decades.

In this role, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of commercial and industrial HVAC systems, including boilers and chillers. We are looking for dedicated individuals ready to contribute their expertise and grow with a company that values its employees.
requirements: Minimum 5-7 years of experience as an HVAC Technician
At least 3 years of commercial HVAC experience, including boilers and chillers
Experience in Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNF) is a plus
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate ranges from $35.00 to $60.00, based on experience and qualifications.
